name: condemned
summary: Convicts in welded scrap: hold ground and grind. Tight spacing for mutual support, they assault through an ambush and they almost never break contact.

movement.why: halted in cover: herringbone, alternate flanks watched
halted in the open: coil, all-round security
screening: a line watches the widest frontage
support by fire: every gun on the objective
the Condemned close up and grind: a line of armour, straight at them
contact possible: wedge, the heaviest hull in front
nothing in sight: column, save the fuel
